sloka: चकम्पे जगती चैव ववुर्वाताः सुदारुणाः ।अक्षोभ्यः क्षुभितश्चैव समुद्रः सरितां पतिः ।। ७.९.३१ ॥
transliteration: cakampe jagatī caiva vavurvātāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ।akṣobhyaḥ kṣubhitaścaiva samudraḥ saritāṁ patiḥ ।। 7.9.31 ॥

translations.english: The earth trembled, very fierce winds blew, and even the unshakeable ocean, the lord of rivers, became agitated.
